# A Recap of Our Multimodal AI in Media & Entertainment Hackathon in Sunny Los Angeles!
## [Incredible Projects Built](https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/la-hackathon-recap#incredible-projects-built)
### [Winning Projects](https://www.twelvelabs.io/blog/la-hackathon-recap#winning-projects)
1. **🏆** [**ThirteenLabs Smart AI Editor**](https://devpost.com/software/thirteenlabs-smart-ai-editor) **(1st Place)**: This advanced video processing application that utilizes AI to edit videos based on user-defined prompts. This app can create highlight reels from sports press conferences or YouTube videos, generate video descriptions, and provide video dubbing in different languages. It leverages various AI models to deliver high-quality video editing and transcription services. 👉 [Video Demo](https://youtu.be/YCe7DJ0cx-4)
